Class TreeNSGAII

java.lang.Object
org.uma.evolver.algorithm.nsgaii.BaseNSGAII<DerivationTreeSolution>
org.uma.evolver.meta.algorithm.TreeNSGAII
All Implemented Interfaces:
BaseLevelAlgorithm<DerivationTreeSolution>
public class TreeNSGAII extends BaseNSGAII<DerivationTreeSolution>
A configurable NSGA-II for derivation tree solutions (DerivationTreeSolution), used as a meta-optimizer with the tree encoding. The problem must be a TreeMetaOptimizationProblem: its TreeMetaOptimizationProblem.solutionGenerator() is handed to the mutation parameter, which needs it to regenerate subtrees.

The parameter space is expected to be built with a TreeParameterFactory (see NSGAIIMetaTree.yaml).
